<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 99.1 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>Section&nbsp;13(r) Disclosure </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><I>The
disclosure reproduced below was initially included in the Quarterly Report on Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">10-Q</FONT> filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission by BlackRock, Inc. (&#8220;BlackRock&#8221; or the
&#8220;Company&#8221;) with respect to its fiscal quarter ended March&nbsp;31, 2026, in accordance with Section&nbsp;13(r) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, regarding activities at Malaysia Airport Holdings Berhad, in which certain
funds and entities affiliated with Global Infrastructure Management, LLC (&#8220;Global Infrastructure Partners&#8221;), a consolidated subsidiary of BlackRock, obtained a minority <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-controlling</FONT> interest.
HPS Real Assets Lending Company LP did not independently verify or participate in the preparation of the disclosure reproduced below. </I></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><U>BlackRock
included the following disclosure in its Quarterly Report on Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">10-Q</FONT> for the fiscal quarter ended March</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;31, 2026:</U> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Certain funds and entities affiliated with Global Infrastructure Partners, a consolidated subsidiary of the Company, obtained a minority <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-controlling</FONT> interest in Malaysia Airport Holdings Berhad in March 2025. Malaysia Airport Holdings Berhad is the operator of Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KUL) and 38 other airports in Malaysia, as well as
Sabiha Gokcen International Airport (SAW) in Istanbul, Turkey. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Malaysia Airport Holdings Berhad provided the below information in connection with
activities during the fiscal quarter ended March&nbsp;31, 2026. We have not independently verified this information or confirmed whether activities contained therein are subject to the Iran Threat Reduction and Syria Human Rights Act of 2012. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Malaysia Airport Holdings Berhad informed the registrant that through February&nbsp;28, 2026, Iran Airtour operated flights to one airport that Malaysia
Airport Holdings Berhad operates. Malaysia Airport Holdings Berhad does not track profits specifically attributable to these activities. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This disclosure
does not relate to any activities conducted directly by the registrant and relates solely to activities conducted by Malaysia Airport Holdings Berhad. </P>
</DIV></Center>
